entities.summary: Wilibald Swibert Joseph Gottlieb von Besser, known in Russia as Vilibald Gotlibovich Besser, was an Austrian-born botanist active in former eastern territories of Poland occupied by the Russian Empire, who worked most of his life within today's territory of western Ukraine.
